div.div: جَدِعٌ (tropical:) A child having bad food; or fed on bad food: (S, K, TA:) pronounced by El-Mufaddal with ذ; but As repudiated to him this pronunciation; (S, TA:) and his objection was confirmed by a young man of the Benoo-Asad called in as an umpire. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
